thesis: The qualified causal dip ensemble retains its cost-adjusted edge while a compact holding-time neighborhood distributes positive final-segment profit across both SPY and QQQ.
rationale: The immutable v1 experiment passed every hard gate except symbol profit concentration. A bounded minute-level exit diagnostic then found a contiguous 114 to 118 minute region with 100 historical trades, positive 1.5-times-cost returns in train, validation, and the development final segment, profit factors above 1.4, and final positive-profit concentration between 0.58 and 0.63. This proposal freezes the lower, baseline, and upper holding-time points before its formal run.
